_comment: Copy to mobile-config.json (gitignored) and fill in PER DEVICE. Never commit a real key.
bootstrap  The LAN-local DHT bootstrap printed by `npm run bootstrap` on a laptop or either
phone. Omit entirely to use the public Holepunch DHT (needs internet).
wallet     This device's TESTNET wallet. The asker signs vouchers with it; the health worker
only needs `address` (its earnings address). voucherDomain must match the deployed
ConduitEscrow — see contracts/deployed.local.json or the Sepolia addresses in the
root README. `epoch` is the channel epoch the asker opened WHILE STILL ONLINE.
offer      Health worker only: what this device advertises. priceBaseUnits is USD₮ base units
